in_sanskrit.name: हनुमान
in_sanskrit.meaning: God of strength, God of monkeys, son of wind
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Hanumān is derived from the Sanskrit words hanu (जनु, jaw) and mān (मान, mind). Hanu means 'jaw' and mān means 'mind'. Hanumān is also called Anjaneya or Anjanadri, which means 'son of Anjani'. Hanumān is the god of strength and is considered the embodiment of the power of devotion. He is also known as the god of monkeys and is the son of the wind god, Vayu.

in_hindi.name: हनुराज
in_hindi.meaning: God of strength, king of monkeys
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Hansraj is derived from the Hindi words hanu (हनु, jaw) and rāj (राज, king). Hanu means 'jaw' and rāj means 'king'. Hansraj is considered a name of great respect and power, symbolizing strength and leadership. It is also associated with the god Hanumān, who is known as the god of strength and the king of monkeys.
